files.bridge.js: let requests=new Map(),sequence=0;function request(action,data){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let id='av-'+Date.now()+'-'+(++sequence),timer=setTimeout(()=>{requests.delete(id);reject(Error('连接超时，请重试'))},20000);requests.set(id,{resolve,reject,timer});parent.postMessage({type:'atom:experience',id,action,data},'*')})}addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.source!==parent)return;let d=e.data||{};if(d.type==='atom:experience-voice'&&d.text){document.querySelector('#prompt').value=d.text;status('语音已填入，确认后生成')}let q=requests.get(d.id);if(!q)return;requests.delete(d.id);clearTimeout(q.timer);if(d.error)q.reject(Error(typeof d.error==='string'?d.error:d.error.message||'请求失败'));else q.resolve(d.result||d.data||d)});let busy=false;async function generate(kind,state,apply){if(busy||!loaded)return;const prompt=document.querySelector('#prompt').value.trim()||(kind==='duet'?'请根据我演奏的旋律接奏一段，保持连贯与对话感':'');if(kind==='visual'&&!prompt)return status('描述你想看到的材质和运动');busy=true;document.querySelector('#generate').disabled=true;try{let r=await request('generate',{kind,prompt,state});let job=r.job;if(!job||!job.id)throw Error('未收到任务编号');status('已提交 · 等待模型');for(let i=0;i<180;i++){if(stopped)return;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));r=await request('job',{job_id:job.id});job=r.job;if(!job)throw Error('任务状态不可用');status(job.phase||({'queued':'正在排队','running':'正在创作','completed':'创作完成'})[job.status]||job.status);if(job.status==='completed'){await apply(job.result);return}if(['failed','cancelled','interrupted'].includes(job.status))throw Error(job.error||'生成未完成，请重试')}throw Error('任务等待较久，请稍后重试')}catch(e){status(e.message)}finally{busy=false;document.querySelector('#generate').disabled=!loaded}}function status(s){document.querySelector('#status').textContent=s}let loaded=false,stopped=false;AtomApp.deferReady();async function saveState(value){if(!loaded)return;try{let r=await AtomApp.save(value);status(r.mode==='preview'?'已保存到临时预览':'已保存到此设备')}catch(e){status('保存失败，请重试')}}AtomApp.onSuspend(()=>{stopped=true;requests.forEach(q=>{clearTimeout(q.timer);q.reject(Error('应用已退出'))});requests.clear()});
